definition: A form used to claim deductions for this document of business and investment property, make elections to expense certain property under section 179, and report information on business use of vehicles and listed property.

includes.text: Contains sections for claiming depreciation deductions on property placed in service during the tax year
Includes election to expense certain qualified property
Reports special depreciation allowances for qualified property
Contains information on listed property including vehicles and their business use percentage
Includes amortization of intangible costs and other amortizable items

excludes.text: Does not report farm income and loss like a farming business return does
Does not report rental real estate income and loss allocations
Does not report employee business expenses using standard mileage or actual expense method

discriminators.text: Reports this document for all types of business property; the sibling is limited to depreciation of farming business property only
discriminators.quote: Depreciation and Amortization (Including Information on Listed Property)

discriminators.text: Reports depreciation on property from all business and investment activities; the sibling reports rental real estate income and loss with depreciation limited to rental properties
Reports depreciation and section 179 deductions for business property; the sibling reports employee business expenses and vehicle deductions using standard mileage or actual expenses
